title.value: GIANT: Scalable Creation of a Web-scale Ontology
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at multiple places, including the abstract and reference sections.
title.quote: GIANT: Scalable Creation of a Web-scale Ontology

analysis.description: The paper presents GIANT, a mechanism for constructing a user-centered, web-scale, structured ontology by mining vast amounts of web documents and search click graphs. It utilizes graph-neural-network-based techniques and evaluates their performance against various baselines, with deployment in real-world applications among several Tencent services.

type.justification: The paper involves evaluating the proposed methods against baseline methods and presents experimental results, thereby classifying it as empirical.
type.quote: We present our graph-neural-network-based techniques used in GIANT, and evaluate the proposed methods as compared to a variety of baselines.

name.justification: The paper focuses primarily on the creation of a user-centered ontology from web-scale data, utilizing deep learning techniques.
name.quote: In this paper, we propose GIANT, a web-based, structured ontology construction mechanism.

name.justification: GCTSP-Net is presented as a novel multi-task model for mining phrases and forming part of the GIANT ontology construction technique.
name.quote: we propose GCTSP-Net (Graph Convolution-Traveling Salesman Problem Network), a multi-task model which can mine different types of phrases at scale.
